A React component calls `useFeatureFlag("flag-name")`. The hook reads a global store that is backed by `localStorage`, subscribes to it, and returns `false` when the flag is off or was never registered.

**How it works**

- `useFeatureFlag` (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/useFeatureFlag.ts:18-23`) pulls `flags` from `featureFlagsStore` via `useStore`, then returns `flags[flagName]?.enabled ?? false`. Because it goes through `useStore`, the component re-renders when a flag is toggled.
- The store itself is defined in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-feature-flags/src/feature-flags.ts:14-27`. It is initialised from `localStorage` (`openmrs:feature-flag:<name>` keys, lines 29-42), and every change is written back to `localStorage` (lines 19-27).
- A flag only exists in the store once it is registered. `registerFeatureFlag` (lines 54-65) adds it and keeps its current enabled state. Registration happens from `routes.json` (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-routes/src/loaders/components.ts:170`) or from code.
- Toggling happens in the Implementer Tools Feature Flags tab (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-implementer-tools-app/src/feature-flags/feature-flags.component.tsx:86`), which calls `setFeatureFlag` (`esm-feature-flags/src/feature-flags.ts:112-119`). The app shell can also turn flags on for everyone through the `Enabled feature flags` config key (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/shell/esm-app-shell/src/core-config.ts:10-23`).
- Non-React code uses `getFeatureFlag` (lines 91-93) or `subscribeToFeatureFlag` (lines 105-109). Both are in `feature-flags.ts`.
- Extensions declared with a `featureFlag` property are dropped when that flag is off (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-extensions/src/extensions.ts:142` and `:476`).

**Documentation**

- The main guide is `openmrs-contrib-o3-docs/content/en-US/docs/feature-flags.mdx`. It covers registering a flag in `routes.json`, using `useFeatureFlag`, and enabling flags through config. The guide says `useFeatureFlag` returns `false` for absent flags.
- The API reference is `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-framework/docs/functions/useFeatureFlag.md`, linked from `esm-framework/docs/API.md` (line 208-210).
- The hook is exported from `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/public.ts:22`.

**Caveat:** `getFeatureFlag` does not guard against unregistered flags. It reads `flags[flagName].enabled`, which throws if the flag is missing. `useFeatureFlag` uses optional chaining and does not have this problem. The `en-US` guide says the same thing (line 10).
